## Market Structure & Technical Context

ADAUSD has printed a classic double bottom pattern on the H1 timeframe, bouncing cleanly off multi-touch support near the 0.2008 swing low area. The Elliott Wave engine identifies Wave C in progress under a bullish structural bias that aligns seamlessly with the reversal pattern. CFD physics shows clean laminar congestion flow with positive momentum alignment, indicating that selling pressure has dried up and buyers are firmly stepping in at value.

Momentum metrics confirm the shift in control, with the RSI printing a healthy 62.1% and the EMA20 (0.2062) crossing above the EMA50 (0.2056). With an ATR of 0.0013, the stop loss is tightly secured at 0.2041, offering an attractive 1:1.5 risk-to-reward ratio targeting the 0.2108 resistance objective.

## Key Levels

- **Resistance**: 0.2108 (Algorithm Take Profit target) / 0.2082 (Pattern Neckline)
- **Support**: 0.2041 (Stop Loss level) / 0.2008 (Structural Low)

## Invalidation Level

A decisive H1 close below the 0.2041 stop loss level invalidates the double bottom pattern and points toward a continuation of the prior corrective leg.

## Macro & Flow Context

Positive regulatory developments and institutional crypto brokerage adoption continue to improve broader digital asset risk sentiment, providing a favorable backdrop for altcoin mean-reversion setups.
